name: basic-session
description: A normal working session: guidance at start, a relevant note on a prompt, a read, a capture with the turn's receipt, a file edit, a quiet Stop and session-end housekeeping.

notes.title: Use tabs for indentation
notes.body: The user prefers tabs over spaces in every file.

notes.title: Cache eviction policy
notes.body: The cache uses LRU eviction with a 500 entry cap.

payload.prompt: what is our cache eviction policy zebra

cli: Cache entries expire after ten minutes
A TTL of ten minutes applies on top of LRU.
